resources.name: Blanchet House
resources.summary: No-questions-asked meals plus clothing, hygiene items, sleeping essentials, and seasonal heat-relief water.
resources.availabilityNote: Meals are offered Monday through Saturday. Clothing inventory and seasonal relief vary; use the official service page for current details.
resources.sourceDetail: Official service and FAQ pages list the downtown address, meals, clothing, hygiene items, and access conditions.

resources.name: Soliguide
resources.address: Online service covering supported areas in France
resources.summary: A multilingual solidarity map for nearby meals, drinking water, shelters, day centres, showers, laundry, clothing, health care, and administrative support.
resources.availabilityNote: Coverage and schedules are updated by area. Open each listing for its current hours and contact instructions.
resources.sourceDetail: Soliguide's official directory searches mapped solidarity services by need and location.

resources.name: Bahnhofsmission Germany
resources.summary: A nationwide finder for station missions offering immediate help without registration, including food, drink, clothing, first aid, a safe place, travel assistance, and local referrals.
resources.availabilityNote: Opening hours differ by station. Use the official finder to choose a location and check its current hours.
resources.sourceDetail: The official network and Deutsche Bahn describe immediate, free help and provide locations and opening hours for station missions.

resources.name: Drinking fountains for London
resources.costNote: Free access to healthy tap water.

resources.availabilityNote: Fountains are located in busy and accessible areas across London, including stations, parks, and high streets. Subject to Thames Water programming and local authority commitments.

resources.sourceKind: Official service locator or guidance page

resources.verifiedQuote: "provide free access to healthy tap water"
resources.coverageNote: Coverage area: Greater London area. The map marker is geographic context, not a single service address.

resources.name: Cool It! NYC
resources.costNote: The service is free of charge to the public.
resources.summary: Cool It! NYC provides a map of drinking fountains, spray showers, and outdoor pools across New York City. It helps residents find places to stay cool and hydrate during the summer.
resources.availabilityNote: In general, spray showers are turned on when the temperature reaches 80 degrees or higher. Drinking fountains are turned on each year.
resources.sourceName: New York City Department of Parks & Recreation
resources.sourceKind: Official service locator or guidance page
resources.sourceDetail: The official NYC Parks website provides a map of drinking fountains, spray showers, and outdoor pools available to the public.
resources.verifiedQuote: Cool It! NYC is a Citywide plan to increase the amount of cooling features available to the public during heat emergencies
resources.coverageNote: Coverage area: New York City. The map marker is geographic context, not a single service address.

resources.name: International Emergency Services
resources.costNote: The services are provided at no cost to individuals affected by disasters and conflict.
resources.summary: The Salvation Army's International Emergency Services (IES) provides critical relief, including food, water, and emergency shelter, to communities affected by disasters and conflict worldwide. The program supports local territories in disaster preparedness and response to meet immediate needs and build resilience.
resources.availabilityNote: Services are deployed in response to disasters and conflicts globally, providing immediate relief and long-term recovery support.
resources.sourceKind: Official network page published by the operator
resources.sourceDetail: The official page states that IES empowers individuals and communities by meeting immediate needs without discrimination.
resources.verifiedQuote: "meeting immediate needs and building resilience in relationship with others and without discrimination"
resources.coverageNote: Coverage area: Global disaster response network. The map marker is geographic context, not a single service address.
